messages:
maya: FYI starting a guarded canary for rwd-v3-int4 that includes cache-seed + a coldstart shadow probe. plan: 1% (12h) -> 8% (18h) -> 25% (12h). Auto-rollback if longdoc_mrr <= -0.015 OR hallucination_rate_delta > 0.02 OR p99_latency_ms_delta > 90ms. seeding slices: legal_longdocs, finance_reports with 400 requests each.

kevin: quick offline AB (n=8k) shows longdoc_mrr_delta = -0.012, p50_latency = -30ms, halluc_rate = +0.007. starting slice bootstrap for CI.

sasha: please add trace flags: kv_cache_stats, tokenization_diff, model_tokens_breakdown. also enable a shadow route that only runs coldstart-only samples so we can separate warming effects. paste the YAML to wire into eval runner.

maya: YAML pushed to canary controller and cache seeds scheduled. holding at 1% until bootstrap CI lands (ETA ~2h). tagging eng-sre + product for visibility.

deploy-bot: canary rwd-v3-int4-seedshadow started at 1739998888 route=hosted/us-west initial_pct=1 dashboard:/canaries/rwd-v3-int4-seedshadow

arjun: reminder: capture the first-1000 requests' cache_hit_rate and annotate requests from seeded slices (`seeded=true`) so we can filter analysis. also capture worst-case coldstart delta.

maya: acknowledged. trace flags set, annotations enabled. will post bootstrap CI and step metrics once available. :thumbsup:
